fields.label: User
fields.description: The Frappe user this memory belongs to. One row per user (unique), so per-user isolation is a primary-key/unique-index guarantee regardless of write path or concurrency. The doc name is an opaque hash (autoname), so the user's email is never a doc name.

fields.label: Content
fields.description: The agent's durable, terse memory blob for this user (one line per fact), curated and full-replaced by the remember tool. Treated as DATA, never instructions, by the agent. Bench-owned, per-user durable memory that replaces the agent's shared-workspace MEMORY.md.
